description: My great-grandparents came to this region from Quebec to work in the paper mills. For generations, my family—like thousands of families across western Maine—was supported by good jobs in manufacturing and industry. Those jobs allowed people who worked hard to buy a home, raise a family, and build a good life here.My generation is the first in more than 100 years to come of age without a large industrial employer providing that same foundation in our town.
